content.learning_goal: Teach the central ideas of Patterns in Mathematics accurately and accessibly.

explanation_sections.title: Connect
explanation_sections.explanation: Activate prior knowledge and invite a prediction.

explanation_sections.title: Explain
explanation_sections.explanation: Build understanding from the source-grounded evidence.
source_evidence: Mathematics is, in large part, the search for patterns, and for the explanations as to why those patterns exist.
Such patterns indeed exist all around us — in nature, in our homes and schools, and in the motion of the sun, moon, and stars.
They occur in everything that we do and see, from shopping and cooking, to throwing a ball and playing games, to understanding weather patterns and using technology.
The search for patterns and their explanations can be a fun and creative endeavour.
